sv.title: Allt dyrare att driva ridskola: ”Vi är absolut oroliga”
sv.summary: Kraftigt ökade kostnader pressar landets ridskolor. När ridavgifterna och ridlektionerna blir dyrare riskerar fler barn att inte längre ha råd att rida. Enligt Svenska Ridsportförbundet har avgifterna för barn och unga ökat med 29 procent sedan 2020.

en.title: Running a riding school is getting more expensive: "We are absolutely worried"
en.summary: Sharply rising costs are putting pressure on the country's riding schools. As riding fees and riding lessons become more expensive, more children risk no longer being able to afford to ride. According to the Swedish Equestrian Federation, fees for children and young people have risen by 29 percent since 2020.
